description.zh-CN: 面向 Coding 用户的 DSH 整合包：Codex 风格工作区侧栏与轮次导航、/review 独立子 Agent 代码审查、/simplify Git 范围代码简化、只读旁问、Codex 式思考强度连续滑块、费用与余额计量、DeepSeek 鲸鱼娘桌宠、AST 上下文压缩与 token 预算守卫、消息回改、Git 分支图。基座 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2，全部插件已逐一校验 peer 兼容与 UI 插槽不冲突。
description.en-US: A coding-oriented DSH modpack: Codex-style workspace sidebar and turn navigation, /review independent code review, /simplify Git-scoped simplification, read-only side-ask, Codex-style reasoning-effort slider, cost and balance metering, a DeepSeek whale-girl desk pet, AST context compression with token budget guard, message re-edit, and a Git graph. Built for DSH 0.1.7-rc.2; every plugin verified for peer compatibility and non-overlapping UI slots.
